infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ABHAYA uses your location only during an emergency or active safe journey.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: ABHAYA may use background location for an active journey where platform rules allow it. Location sharing is off by default.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ABHAYA uses the camera only when you explicitly start evidence mode.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ABHAYA uses the microphone only when you explicitly start evidence mode.
